text: Kingsmoor FC builds carefully from a throw-in deep in their own half on the right side. The ball moves through midfield in a series of short passes between Hamza Strand and Rafael Sato, gradually advancing toward Westport Albion’s goal at the far end. Viktor Quinlan then receives a long pass near the left flank of the attacking third and quickly plays a short ball to Felix Duarte, positioned about 4 metres from goal just inside the penalty area. Duarte shoots with his foot, but the ball goes off target, keeping the score tied at 2-2 [#695] [#709] [#710] [#713].
